summary: Ambow Education Holding Ltd. filed an 8-K on July 30, 2026, announcing via press release the general availability of its HybriU AI Adaptive Course Generation Platform, a new AI-powered product within its flagship HybriU suite. The platform converts institutional knowledge into personalized learning applications, targeting the corporate training market. The filing is a routine product launch disclosure under Item 8.01, with no financial terms, board actions, or special-situation mechanics. It does not involve any M&A, capital markets activity, or structural event, and no deal terms are stated. This is a standard operational announcement, not a special situation.
